project.title: Pilot Deployment of Smart Battery Monitoring System
project.objective: Design, test, and commission a smart battery monitoring system for a pilot energy storage installation, validating performance, safety, and integration with existing infrastructure.
deliverables: System architecture and technical requirements specification
Laboratory test plan and validation report for monitoring hardware and algorithms
Pilot site installation design and electrical integration drawings
Commissioning and acceptance test procedures with results
Operational guidelines and safety checklist for site technicians
Post-pilot performance and feasibility assessment report
constraints: Pilot system must comply with relevant electrical safety and grid interconnection standards
Hardware and sensors must be compatible with existing battery racks and BMS interfaces
Laboratory validation must be completed before any on-site installation
Pilot downtime window for installation is limited to one weekend
Budget restricts custom hardware; preference for off-the-shelf components
All documentation must be version-controlled and auditable

risks.risk: Laboratory test results reveal instability or inaccurate state-of-charge estimation.
risks.mitigation: Iterate on algorithms with additional test cycles and define fallback thresholds before field deployment.

risks.risk: Pilot site installation conflicts with existing electrical layout or capacity limits.
risks.mitigation: Perform detailed feasibility study and load analysis with updated site drawings before final design freeze.

risks.risk: Commissioning window is missed due to delays in hardware delivery or lab validation.
risks.mitigation: Pre-qualify alternative suppliers and stage partial pre-commissioning tests in the lab environment.

risks.risk: Non-compliance with safety standards leads to additional approvals or rework.
risks.mitigation: Engage safety and compliance officer early to review requirements and sign off on designs and procedures.

risks.risk: Data collected during pilot is insufficient to draw conclusions on long-term performance.
risks.mitigation: Define minimum data set and sampling strategy upfront and extend pilot duration if early data is inconclusive.

themes.why_relevant: Bridges controlled test results with real-world performance and informs design margins.
Battery systems and monitoring must meet strict electrical and lab safety standards.
Monitoring must integrate with existing BMS, SCADA, and site electrical infrastructure.
Tight site downtime window requires precise planning and clear procedures.
Reliable data is needed to evaluate feasibility and justify scaling beyond the pilot.

backlog.task: Define system architecture and detailed technical requirements for the smart battery monitoring pilot.
definition_of_done: Requirements document reviewed by electrical engineer and commissioning engineer
Interfaces to existing BMS and SCADA clearly specified
Safety and compliance requirements explicitly listed
Version-controlled document stored and linked in project workspace

backlog.task: Develop laboratory test plan and procedures for validating sensors and monitoring algorithms.
definition_of_done: Test matrix covers temperature, load profiles, and fault scenarios
Lab safety procedures integrated into test steps
Test plan approved by safety and compliance officer
Test plan stored in shared repository with version history

backlog.task: Execute laboratory tests and produce validation report for monitoring system performance.
definition_of_done: All planned tests executed or deviations documented
Raw data archived with clear labeling and metadata
Key performance metrics summarized with pass/fail criteria
Validation report reviewed and signed off by project team

backlog.task: Create electrical integration design and wiring diagrams for pilot site installation.
definition_of_done: Single-line diagrams and wiring schematics completed in CAD
Load and protection calculations documented
Design reviewed for compliance with site standards
Drawings released with revision control and shared with commissioning engineer

backlog.task: Perform feasibility study of pilot site constraints and installation options.
definition_of_done: Existing site layout and electrical capacity assessed
Installation options compared with pros/cons
Risks and required shutdown windows identified
Feasibility summary shared and agreed with operations manager

backlog.task: Prepare commissioning and acceptance test procedures for the pilot system.
definition_of_done: Step-by-step commissioning checklist drafted
Functional and safety tests clearly defined with expected results
Procedures reviewed by research engineer and electrical engineer
Final version stored and linked for on-site use

backlog.task: Coordinate and execute on-site installation and commissioning of the monitoring system.
definition_of_done: Installation completed within agreed downtime window
All commissioning tests executed and logged
Any defects recorded with follow-up actions
Operations team briefed on system status and handover completed

backlog.task: Draft operational guidelines and safety checklist for ongoing use of the monitoring system.
definition_of_done: Normal operation, alarms, and escalation paths documented
Safety precautions and lockout/tagout steps included
Guidelines reviewed by commissioning engineer and safety officer
Checklist formatted for easy use by site technicians

backlog.task: Define data collection, storage, and analysis approach for the pilot phase.
definition_of_done: Key metrics and sampling rates defined
Data retention and access rules agreed with operations
Data schema and naming conventions documented
Plan approved by project team and referenced in pilot report

backlog.task: Produce post-pilot performance and feasibility assessment report with recommendations.
definition_of_done: Pilot data analyzed against success criteria
Issues, incidents, and lessons learned summarized
Recommendation on scaling or redesign clearly stated
Report shared with stakeholders and archived

backlog.task: Review and update electrical design based on lab findings and pilot feedback.
definition_of_done: Change impacts assessed and documented
Updated drawings issued with new revision
Commissioning procedures checked for alignment
Stakeholders informed of design changes

backlog.task: Track and resolve defects or issues identified during commissioning and early operation.
definition_of_done: Issue log created and kept up to date
Root cause and corrective actions documented for each issue
High-priority issues closed or accepted with workaround
Summary shared in post-pilot assessment

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on system requirements, architecture, and pilot scope before lab work starts.
threads_plan.trigger: Initial kick-off message sharing draft requirements and asking for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the final version of the system requirements specification for the pilot.
Agree on the pilot success criteria and key performance metrics.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define and refine the laboratory test plan and validation approach.
threads_plan.trigger: Research engineer posts first draft of the lab test plan for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Sign off on the lab test matrix and safety procedures so testing can start.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalize electrical integration design and confirm site feasibility constraints.
threads_plan.trigger: Electrical engineer shares preliminary integration drawings and asks for site feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm the selected installation option and integration approach for the pilot site.
Freeze the electrical design revision to be used for commissioning preparation.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan and coordinate on-site commissioning activities and responsibilities.
threads_plan.trigger: Commissioning engineer posts draft commissioning checklist and proposed schedule.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the commissioning and acceptance test checklist and schedule.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on operational guidelines, data collection plan, and post-pilot reporting.
threads_plan.trigger: Research engineer shares draft operational guidelines and data plan near pilot start.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve operational guidelines and safety checklist for site technicians.
Confirm structure and ownership of the post-pilot assessment report.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in each morning with yesterday/today/risks updates.
Twice-weekly lab and site status summary post with key findings and open issues.
Design review mini-ritual when a major document revision is shared for comments.
Post-commissioning debrief thread capturing lessons learned and improvement ideas.
